content.overview: A written contract plus possession in part performance shields the transferee from the transferor's title claim, even without a completed registered transfer.
content.study: 53A is a shield, not a sword. It does not confer title. After the 2001 amendment an unregistered contract required to be registered cannot be received as evidence of the contract for this section — read the current proviso on the official text before you plead.
